correctness.rationale: Exact binary matrix recurrences give normalized M1 times U,V word. Over odd moduli U,V generate SL2; U^m and (UV^{m-1}U)^4 yield coprime return lengths, proving aperiodicity. Uniform stationary measure yields exponential complete-dyadic-block mixing, and binary cylinder decomposition yields o(N) discrepancy on arbitrary prefixes. Counting compatible second columns proves the primitive-pair law; alternating determinant parity and prefix mixing prove raw matrix liminf/limsup. Exact finite code reproduced the recurrences and group counts, but no finite computation was used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Natural and motivated joint arithmetic object formed by adjacent values of two classical Stern recurrences; complete matrix distribution over all odd moduli, the induced primitive-pair density, and a sharp dyadic nonconvergence boundary for raw matrices. The matrix result is strictly more informative than any single Stern or twisted Stern marginal distribution and reveals a necessary sign normalization, with structural SL2 explanation.
